sloka: अथवा दुर्बलः क्लीबो बलं धर्मो ऽनुवर्तते।दुर्बलो हृतमर्यादो न सेव्य इति मे मतिः ।। ६.८३.२६ ।।
transliteration: athavā durbalaḥ klībo balaṁ dharmo 'nuvartate।durbalo hṛtamaryādo na sevya iti me matiḥ ।। 6.83.26 ।।

translations.english: "Or else dharma becomes feeble, ineffective, submits to might, then it is better not to follow such dharma which is feeble, I think."
